scope: Single preregistered forward-central nominee only. Boundary-to-rule forecasts are a different, supervised stage from training the central representation, never an additional operator search. No native access without stage release. No reuse of reverse study outputs. No assessment interiors before public prediction commit. Nothing here authorizes cavities or additional physical configurations.
Geometry: z,y,x; V=27 and E=386 as in design.json. R5 substitutes +/-5 for +/-4 in coords; all shell operators (including induced nearest-neighbor graph and phase masks) rebuilt from those physical coords. R5 applies the baseline/augmented calibrators separately fit on R5 permitted development data, with R4 critic coefficients frozen and applied by fixed site correspondence; descriptive domain-shift test only. Training of central code never uses R5. Rows are equal-weighted within complete parents.
fixed_targets: f: one rule as supplied by hero_rule.apply_rule, signed FIT-standardized units. Not necessarily rotation invariant.

residual: hero_rule.residual_rule(V,spec), subtracting the frozen conventional central projection FIT learned / TUNE calibrated. Normalize ALL residual comparisons by original Var_fit(f), not by a tiny remaining variance.
conventional: hero_rule.conventional_rule, same estimator, no comparison of two different targets' associations constitutes a shared-outcome win.
features: I=(Nv,NA) inside radius<=3, fixed for both radii, unconditionally identical across primary methods. Inventory model receives I only. Conventional m0 adds shell vacancy/A fractions (B redundant), six face-resolved vacancy/A fractions, oriented +axis lengths 1/2 empirical V-V,A-A,occupancy-occupancy,V->A,A->V pair frequencies and induced-shell partial occupied-neighbor degree histogram by species (0..6, absent sites not imputed). Trial crystal contrast: state-score 1_vac-1_A over all phase indicators r.(1,1,1)=b mod3, and 1_vac-1_B over r.(1,2,3)=b mod7, centered inside-vs-outside mean; proper rotations, all phases, max and RMS. Generic period-five axial vacancy layering, all phases, same summaries. First two achieve coordination 3/5 in pure bulk but NOT an identification of the published crystal structures; 5 is not the Crystal5 wavelength. Includes raw three-axis antipodal face densities for oriented targets. m1 adds K centered frozen critic logits from E (K=4); common additive nonlinear calibration: each FIT z-scored raw feature + its squared z value standardized on FIT. Free intercept, penalties alpha={0.0001,0.01,1} against mean FIT squared error. TUNE selects minimum MSE separately per target/method, exact ties larger alpha; all alpha-matched m1-minus-m0 diagnostics reported. Additional unconditioned (both no-I) sensitivity uses identical pipeline and same target. No repeated label-based fitting on RULE, blind, hot, cold or transfer; no new representational capacity search.
rule_gate: hero_forecast.nominate(banks,targets,shell,names) with split fit,tune,rule and targets [f,residual,(conventional)] per single distillate. No ranking of a slate. On RULE for raw f: both m1 vs m0 and m1 vs inventory gains point>=.01 and one-sided 95% whole-parent lower>0; residual m1 vs m0 point>0 in original variance units and Var_fit(residual)/Var_fit(f)>=.10. Var_fit(f)>1e-8. Independent distillation/stability gates also mandatory. Behind closed exams: no other candidates, no fallback winner.
power_and_support: Target cold margin .01, design alternative g=.02, >=80% projected normal power at n=1024, two-sided 95% lower. SD from RULE parent-mean paired g on first eight translations (approximate; their layout differs from cold). Transfer predeclared g>=.005, two-sided 95% lower>0. Primary effects use all scoring opportunities from complete parents, no exclusion by prediction or outcome. Support: fraction of anchors with exact two-inventory coordinate witnessed on >=8 distinct FIT parents; require >=.90 for cold/transfer/RULE. Publish supported-only sensitivity (ratio of summed signed paired scores to count; whole-parent clustered delta-t CI, including zero-support parents), plus unconditional no-I calibration. Failed support/precision is distinct from a powered tie, not permission to switch temperatures.
freeze_issue_score: FIT signs/scales/variance/weights and TUNE alpha/5 equal-frequency calibration bins/90th percentile |f-m1| fixed before issuing (interval is typical single-interior error, not thermal uncertainty nor a conditional 90% guarantee). Predictions-{role}.npz public (actual basename lower-case predictions-): parent[P],anchor[P,Q], all signed grid and selected forecasts, forecast interval, bins, support, matched groups, high/low sign; receipt predictions-{role}.json with role, blind_sha256, roster_sha256=sha256(parent <i8 bytes || anchor <i8 bytes), opportunities=P*Q, prediction_sha256. Exact roster from bank. Labels hidden-{role}.npz parent,anchor,V only; never hidden-issue. One immutable issuance/one score per role; bank release independent of this code must verify public commit. CIs on parent means using t, two-sided95% except explicitly named one-sided RULE gate. Raw effect=(MSE0-MSE1)/Var_fit(f), residual same denominator. Absolute MSE, inventory-relative gains and signed calibration plot. Cold requires raw lower>.01 AND residual lower>0, hot conditional null controlled; transfer raw lower>0 AND point>=.005, same weights/scales, no adaptation. R5 never promotes. Positive values improve. A cold upper<=.01 means below material margin; a spanning interval unresolved. All physical promotions are joint tests; isolated favorable diagnostics do not promote.
null: Independent native beta0, if released. Cold calibration need not be calibrated at beta0; absolute raw frozen m0/m1 advantage is descriptive. Exact canonical inventory control: 2*Cov(f,m1-m0 | I)/Var_fit(f), estimated within exact I using all cross-parent pairs without sharing a center in the product. Require >=.90 eligible anchors across repeat inventories and two-sided95% parent delete-one jackknife interval contained within [-.01,.01]. Canonical I may be informative even at infinite temperature; raw predictive skill is not a leakage test. Widespread signed null association or inadequate precision stops a positive claim. No generated physical configurations.
matches: Before labels: consider only first precommitted anchor per distinct parent; pair by exact I, |m0_i-m0_j|<=.25 SD_fit(f), largest gap in D=m1-m0 first within a stratum, deterministic parent-ID tie-break, each parent at most once, positive predicted m1 ordering required. Sign high/low by D; report all parents even unmatched and full opportunity coverage. >=16 matched pairs to describe a grouped contrast, otherwise explicitly unsupported. Pair score is mean f_high-f_low, sign fraction and pair-t intervals (whole disjoint parent pairs). Not equilibration, not repeated interior physics. No high-low subgroup rescues failure of all-opportunity endpoint.
numeric_forecast_control: One immutable numerical-control receipt before native forecasts, not a substitute for full forward-encoder control. Seed 1795526371; independent abstract pseudo-parents split FIT 8192, TUNE 2048, RULE 8192, eight draws each. f=(U + B)/sqrt(2), conventional=B and residual=U/sqrt(2); independent Rademacher bits U,B. Identical side channel I reveals B in all methods; ordinary independent junk bits, a frozen shell-evidence bit C through a binary symmetric channel of correlation sqrt(2g) to U; oracle gain g and ordinary baseline MSE=.5, both exact. Benchmarks g=.02,.125,0; null shuffles C across whole pseudo-parents independently per split. Require weak and strong rule gate, respective g point within .007/.015 of oracle and lower>.01; null two-sided95% CI contained within [-.005,.005] and gate fails. All share nuisance, training, variance and parent score machinery; no parent split leakage. No retry or retuned native pipeline on failure. A limited-stage failure doesn't measure glass memory.
